skill.displayName: AI Baby Generator – See Your Future Baby Face in Seconds – API-powered
skill.summary: AI baby face generator — predict what a baby would look like from two parent photos

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the baby-face-generator skill.
- Predicts what a baby would look like using two parent photos.
- Integrates with WeShop's OpenAPI, including secure API key handling and HTTPS requirements.
- Supports uploading images, running predictions, and polling run status.
- Customizable generation options: batch size, parent image input, and text instructions.
- Full API documentation and usage guide included.
